text:
Outside there is sun.

It is nothing but a sun

But men look at it

and then they sing.

I know nothing of the sun.

I know the angel's melody

and the hot sermon

of the last wind.

I know how to scream until dawn

when death settles naked

on my shadow.

I weep beneath my name.

I wave handkerchiefs in the night

and thirsty for reality

they dance with me

I hide nails

to mock my sick dreams.

Outside there is sun.

I dress myself in ashes.

translation.title: Outside There Is Sun...
translation.editorial_note: This version mirrors the related poem while preserving it as a separate translated source text.
